Record Class SkillDefinition.OrchestrationConfig

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
tech.kayys.wayang.agent.skill.SkillDefinition.OrchestrationConfig
Record Components:
defaultType - Default orchestration type: SEQUENTIAL, PARALLEL, COLLABORATIVE, etc.
defaultStrategy - Default coordination strategy: CENTRALIZED, DISTRIBUTED, HIERARCHICAL
defaultChildSkills - Skill IDs auto-spawned when this orchestrator is created
maxIterations - Max orchestration iterations
maxDelegations - Max delegation count
Enclosing class:
SkillDefinition
public static record SkillDefinition.OrchestrationConfig(String defaultType, String defaultStrategy, List<String> defaultChildSkills, Integer maxIterations, Integer maxDelegations) extends Record
Orchestration configuration for orchestrator-type skills.
